title: Zeta functions of $\mathrm{PGL}_n$ over non-Archimedean local fields
summary: Let $\mathscr{B}$ be the Bruhat--Tits building of $\mathrm{PGL}_n(F)$, where $F$ is a non-Archimedean local field. We introduce geometric $k$-geodesics in $\mathscr{B}$ by means of CAT(0) convexity and combinatorial $k$-geodesics by a local successor relation on pointed $k$-facets. We prove that the two notions coincide. This allows us to use the local combinatorial definition on quotients $Γ\backslash\mathscr{B}$, without referring to the universal covering.
